name: Automotive Technology
old_description: ATI has been selling paint booths for over 30 years! We were one of the first distributors to introduce Downdraft paint booths to the market in the 1980’s. Back then they were Saico paint booths imported from Italy. In 2006, we began selling Global Finishing Solutions (GFS) paint booths. GFS is the largest U.S. Manufacturer of paint booths and offers a full line of booths and related equipment;
about:
Automotive Technology, Inc. (ATI) began in December 1982 and incorporated in 1983 in Fenton, Missouri. The company started with two employees working from a home office before moving into its own 10,500-square-foot facility.

ATI operates as a full-line distributor and service provider for the automotive and collision repair industry. The company sells and installs equipment from manufacturers such as Hunter Engineering (alignment systems, wheel balancers, tire changers), Global Finishing Solutions (paint booths), Rotary (lifts), Chief (frame racks and measuring), Prospot (welding), and Graco (lubrication). Its service department handles paint booth installation and maintenance, lift installation and repair (both in-ground and above-ground), diagnostic equipment service, on-site brake lathe repair, frame rack and welder service, and wheel balancer and tire changer service. ATI is also an authorized repair center for Robinair, Accuturn, and Corgi equipment.

The company serves mechanical repair shops and collision repair facilities throughout the St. Louis metropolitan area, including Chesterfield, Clayton, Florissant, Kirkwood, University City, and Ballwin. Its customer base consists of independent repair shops and body shops requiring equipment sales, installation, and ongoing maintenance.

ATI traces its differentiation to early market adoption; it was one of the first distributors to bring downdraft paint booths to the U.S. in the 1980s, initially importing Saico booths from Italy. The company emphasizes a commitment to follow-through, encapsulated in its stated principle: "We complete what we start, and we do what we say."
